bio.text: Greg Lopez represented Colorado's 4th Congressional District in the U.S. House from July 8, 2024, to January 3, 2025, succeeding Ken Buck.
He is running for governor of Colorado in 2026 as an unaffiliated candidate on a joint ticket with Taralyn Romero.
According to his campaign website, he served in the U.S. Air Force, was elected mayor of Parker at age 27, and is a former Colorado director of the U.S. Small Business Administration.
The site says he lives in Elizabeth in Elbert County.
